the creation of a federation of IoT deployments to provide a common access to the data resources that are generated in these deployments.
the development of an open, interoperable and secure IoT testbed federation that enables the experimental evaluation of IoT solutions in a real-world scenario.

the federation of IoT testbeds can be a powerful instrument to enable the realization of the IoT concept, and that the challenges met during this process can be overcome with the proper mitigation mechanisms.

the federation of testbeds is a challenging task, but it is also a very rewarding process that allows us to offer to experimenters a large number of resources and a wide variety of scenarios.
the federation of testbeds is a feasible approach for the realization of a data marketplace.

the integration of heterogeneous testbeds is a challenging process.
the integration of testbeds with heterogeneous characteristics and requirements is feasible.
the federation is a promising way to increase the number of available resources for IoT experimentation.
